descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · UAT TC-07 ER 7; UAT 3.3 · “Works in both Hospital and Nursing Home.”.

Approach · TC-07 Task Export · S02 Nursing Home: three residents' tasks, one completed, on one screen and in Copy Text, no email

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 One consolidated in-app end-of-day view lists every open task across all of the physician's patients, each attributed to its patient (UAT TC-07; TFA-92585 AC 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr
  • U2 On the view the list is grouped by patient, pending tasks first and completed tasks at the bottom; every task shows which patient it belongs to (UAT TC-07; TFA-92585 AC 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr
  • U3 Copy Text copies the whole list (pending and completed) to the clipboard in the same grouping, every task under its patient; the copy stays on the device (UAT TC-07; TFA-92585 AC 4) — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr
  • U9 'Email Tasks' is absent from the task screen: the button and the functionality, not just unused (UAT TC-07; TFA-92585 AC 11) — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr
  • U10 All of the above works in both Hospital and Nursing Home (UAT TC-07; UAT 3.3; TFA-92585 AC 12) — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given Same as S01 in Nursing Home: three seeded residents on Today's Visits with six tasks (one already done); one Hospital patient with an open task as a bleed probe

When Switch to Nursing Home → Task Export; tick 'PT re-evaluation' as done; expand the completed section; tap Copy Text. The scripted step then reads the clipboard

Then As S01: open tasks under their own resident, completed at the bottom with the resident, no Email control, the clipboard in the same grouping; nothing from the Hospital patient

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): As S01 for /snf/tasks: mustContain/mustNotContain, groupedUnder, attributedTo and same-patient pending-before-completed pairs (Eli, Fay); cross-patient pairs in q5Pairs until Q5; completed tasks missing from the clipboard reported as known (PR #106), also in the pairs that name them

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S02 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-07.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row; the Allure status was changed by the triage from passed to broken.

Issue type: Ticket not ready for QA · environment local · tickets TFA-92585 ready for qa

On the Nursing Home task export, completed tasks show on screen but Copy Text leaves them out; it copies only the open tasks.

Evidence: datasets lane known-gap: the completed block is in PR #106. TFA-92585 is ready for pr (gated). A resident not In Today is absent from the screen and the copy; that is recorded for Q1.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 8b4be94a (10-20 re-run), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: AGENT · Browser agent — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: newspec-c.
